research_informed_by: Vietnamese e-commerce dialogue coverage: ProductInfo, OrderInfo, Shipping and Chatchit; dialogue acts and slot values.
ViWOZ coverage: multi-turn context, dialogue state, user paraphrases and clarification behavior.
BFCL coverage: tool choice, arguments, stateful multi-turn behavior and abstention.
scope: Text only; local API; active runtime catalog plus full dataset validation metadata

rubric: sounds natural in Vietnamese and fits the user's register
does not repeat unnecessary product details
asks a short clarification when the target is ambiguous
